result.title: Computationally Efficient Offline Policy Optimization with All-Policy Linear Realizability
result.summary: We study offline policy optimization in finite-horizon Markov decision processes where every deterministic Markov policy has an action-value function linear in known features, with coefficient norm at most $B$. From independent complete trajectories of one unknown Markov behavior policy, and under all-policy occupancy coverage, we give an algorithm with $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ sample dependence and computational complexity polynomial in $\log(2+B)$. The algorithm performs exactly one convex regression per layer. Its stopped-return targets are the values of a single consistent Markov witness policy. A shared reference design and bounded prediction constraints convert fast clipped-regression error into pointwise confidence for the raw linear predictions. Truncated leverage controls the performance loss without requiring empirical covariance approximation at scale $B^{-2}$. Rounding confidence radii upward preserves the exact witness and yields a polynomial-time bit implementation for rational numerical inputs. The guarantees allow any fixed initial-state distribution; realizability and coverage need only be checked for deterministic policies. We also establish a covariance-coverage variant with uniform approximate realizability and polynomial dependence on $B$. A two-action lower bound shows that the accuracy exponent $2$ is necessary.

AI.brief_summary: 研究有限时域 MDP 的离线策略优化：在「所有确定性策略的 action-value 均对已知特征线性可实现」这一强假设下，给出样本依赖 Õ(ε^{-2})、计算复杂度仅对 log(2+B) 多项式的算法，每层只做一次凸回归，并配有下界说明 ε 的指数 2 不可改进。
AI.relevance_reason: 「全策略线性可实现＋占用覆盖」配合截断杠杆与置信半径向上取整，可能为核查 latent 状态是否保留任务必要信息、以及由预测误差转为逐点置信提供理论视角，但与视觉推理的状态生成与证据获取机制相距较远，仅供外围借鉴。
